blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. has promoted Land Transportation Office (LTO) chief Assistant Secretary Markus Lacanilao as administrator of the Maritime Industry Authority (Marina), with a rank of undersecretary, according to Malacañang.
